scripts.build:docker: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && eval $(minikube docker-env) && docker buildx build -t localhost:5000/app-web:latest --build-arg VITE_API_URL=http://api.local.com -f Dockerfile $REPO_ROOT
scripts.build:docker:local: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && eval $(minikube docker-env) && docker buildx build -t localhost:5000/app-web:latest --build-arg VITE_API_URL=http://api.local.com -f Dockerfile $REPO_ROOT
scripts.build:docker:prod: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && docker build -t ${DOCKERHUB_USERNAME}/app-web:${TAG:-latest} --build-arg VITE_API_URL=https://api.joemckenney.com -f Dockerfile $REPO_ROOT
